CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2844 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e. Bus nonce: 35c20883c951a103bd67e3b2f153312b. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e` or `Fix review: blocked 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 35c20883c951a103bd67e3b2f153312b`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2844 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2844-35c20883`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA REVIEW of #2844 (roster batch 16, now 9 ops), head 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e (roster handoff 7d6ff745, re-cut body at handoff-body/audit-r10-roster 80907bed), bus nonce 35c20883c951a103bd67e3b2f153312b. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA. Record-shaped review.

PRIOR VERDICT: MERGE at ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f (5 ops: append-carry R10-FLOW-JIDOKA, R10-FLY-LEDGER-SAMPLE, R10-FLY-DEPGRAPH-STALE, R10-ORCH-PLANPAGE; set-stage R10-PLAN-ISSUES-CHART done; origin/review/2844 and origin/verdict/2844). That verdict settles those five ops unless the delta changes them. Judge the DELTA ac96f4c3..head, nothing the prior verdict settled.

CHECK:
1. The four new ops, one per commit (git log --format='%h %s' ac96f4c35659..9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e, the roster_edit ones): f802d728c edit-brief R10-IMMERSION-LATCH, b56e9e570 set-stage R10-THERMAL-POWER-OPTION, 0f3251614 set-stage R10-FLOW-RECORD-PITCH, 7d6ff7459 append-carry R10-ORCH-BEATD. Each must cite a merged ruling or merged PR (commit message, the op's note, or the group's brief). For the two set-stage ops, verify the PR the stage claims actually merged: git merge-base --is-ancestor of that PR's merge commit to origin/main (#2753 a441d2e15 and #2836 28800999b are the likely ones); a stage called done at a commit main lacks is a block. For the edit-brief op, show the before/after brief and that nothing was dropped. For the append-carry op, show the carry text and that carry_audit still routes it.
2. The roster file at the head vs origin/main: the three-dot diff of dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json shows exactly the 9 ops and nothing else (python3 a json diff by group). The branch also merged origin/main twice; confirm the 46-file stat in git diff --stat ac96f4c3..head is main's own content (git diff origin/main...head --stat lists only the roster file and the delivery row).
3. No carry is dropped without being re-routed (python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py on the body at this head: 0 unrouted). The body is the re-cut one; it must say 9 ops (the delivery row reads 5 ops in its title if the title was not updated; name it if stale).
4. dev/programme/delivery/2844.md is in the three-dot diff; node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs on the merged tree prints 0 errors (print its output); git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main head exits 0; CI on this head read from the check-runs API (name each red, answer against the body's Red checks).
Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. Its first line is exactly "Fix review: merge 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e" or "Fix review: blocked 9dc2d96330e520e08b2918dd01f58e7d4ffa8a7e <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: 35c20883c951a103bd67e3b2f153312b". Then the body in sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>". Everything else under "## Evidence", with files under ev/, one holding the full 40-hex head. Return the verdict on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2844-35c20883. Do NOT run bus.sh. Do not post comments, approve or merge. Re-read the head with git ls-remote before writing the verdict. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit or comment. Do not name any path under a home directory in the verdict.
